sections.heading: style-121 Chalk on Black Paper — 3 s silent preview

children.value:
Subject: an idea becomes a connected system. 1280×720, 30 fps, 3 s, silent.
Style renderer: Canvas 2D. Motion engine: GSAP. Pipeline: HyperFrames.
Renderer details (seeded paper and tooth textures built once; per-dab chalk strokes rebuilt every frame). Motion: GSAP paused timeline

.
Palette: background #15141A, chalk #F1EBDD (pale passes about 0.2–0.36 alpha, opaque accents about 0.9).

rows.Beat: Heading "An idea becomes / a connected system" wipes in with chalk. Pale halo, outline and glow hatching sketch the light bulb.
Opaque bulb outline, base lines, filament, rays and the heading underline go in. Caption "one spark" wipes in.
Dashed chalk arrow shaft draws toward the network. Its two head strokes start only at 1.70 s, after the shaft is done.
Pale edge halos and edges sketch the network, then opaque node rings and dots go in one after another.
A wide pale halo and an opaque line mark the main path. Caption "many links" wipes in.

children.value: Limitations: noise2D is an inline seeded Perlin stand-in (@remotion/noise is not installed locally). The chalk and paper tooth are procedural approximations.
